text: Iris: Quick FYI from the design review our in-console docs panel currently says 'Docs' in the title, but the CTA reads 'See docs'. Users are hesitating because there's no clear external indicator. Screenshot attached. Tom: Hmm. Microcopy should be consistent. We decided 'Help' for in-app microcopy, and 'Docs' for the canonical site. Suggest header = 'Help' and CTA = 'Open full docs'. Zoe: UX nudge idea: make the CTA include an external icon and small hint 'opens in new tab' so users know it's leaving console. Tooltip on hover. Ken: Dev constraints: if we set target=_blank we must also add rel="noopener noreferrer". Also we should append ?source=panel_cta for analytics. Ravi: Accessibility: close button must have aria-label; CTA needs aria-label that matches visible text + '(opens in new tab)'. Also confirm focus restore to trigger after close. docs-bot: deploy/checklist reminder: please add an acceptance test for focus restore and a unit test that asserts the CTA includes ?source=panel_cta. Iris: Also: can we surface a tiny inline hint below the header: 'Short tips here — open full docs for step-by-step examples.' Keeps panel lightweight but discoverable. Tom: Agree. Copy proposal: header: 'Help', subhead: 'Tips & quick examples', CTA: 'Open full docs (new tab)'. Zoe: Visual: ensure the CTA color passes WCAG AA in dark mode. I'll attach contrast samples. Ken: I'll implement: - change header text - add CTA with Open full docs \u2197 - add aria-labels and focus restore logic Ravi: Tests: keyboard open/close, Escape closes and returns focus, CTA has correct href param and opens in new tab (mock). Also include a screenreader text check for CTA. Iris: Can we also track CTA impression and click events? Metric names: help_panel.impression, help_panel.cta_click. Tom: Good. Ken please link the PR here when ready. Ken: Will do. Draft branch: feature/help-panel-cta-nudge. Will open PR and tag @accessibility and @analytics. Zoe: Small follow-up: consider adding a slimmer 'Learn more' inline link for short references that doesn't open new tab, in case users want quick context without leaving console. Could be another link style. Iris: OK let's scope that for follow-up. For now we standardize header/CTA and land aria + tests. Target: next patch. Ken: PR soon, pinging here once it's up. Ravi: Thanks team. I'll review accessibility changes once PR is out.
